```yaml
descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Summarizes the group landscape by counting groups per group type.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read

skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load Groups
    detail: Load all groups from Microsoft Graph
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All

  - id: count_by_group_type
    format: transform
    label: Count Groups by Type
    detail: Count groups per groupTypes
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_groups.output }}"
      field: groupTypes
      buckets: []

  - id: summarize_landscape
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Landscape
    detail: Summarize group landscape
    settings:
      system: "You are an assistant summarizing group data."
      prompt: "Summarize the following group counts: {{ count_by_group_type.output }}"
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800

  result:
    summary: "Group Landscape Summary: {{ summarize_landscape.output }}"
    data:
      summary: "{{ summarize_landscape.output }}"
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Non-Compliant Models
  description: Summarizes device compliance and lists oldest devices.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read

skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load Managed Devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices with selected fields.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All

  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count Devices by Compliance State
    detail: Counts devices grouped by complianceState.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown

  - id: sort_oldest_10
    format: transform
    label: Sort Oldest Devices
    detail: Sorts devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and takes the oldest 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10

  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Compliance Data
    detail: Generates a summary of compliance counts and oldest devices.
    settings:
      system: "You are an assistant summarizing device compliance data."
      prompt: |
        Summarize the following compliance counts and list of oldest 10 devices:
        Counts: {{ count_by_compliance.output }}
        Oldest devices: {{ sort_oldest_10.output }}
      temperature: 0.7
      maxTokens: 200

definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      counts: "{{ count_by_compliance.output }}"
      oldest_devices: "{{ sort_oldest_10.output }}"
```

```yaml
slug: dormant-guest-accounts
name: Dormant Guest Accounts Summary
description: Loads guest users from Microsoft Graph and summarizes dormant ones.
mode: read
steps:
  - name: fetch-guest-users
    type: api
    description: Retrieve all guest users from Microsoft Graph
    config:
      method: GET
      url: https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users?$filter=userType eq 'Guest'
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{token}}"
  - name: filter-dormant
    type: script
    description: Filter users who have not signed in for over 90 days
    config:
      language: python
      code: |
        import datetime
        dormant = []
        for user in input:
            last_sign_in = user.get('lastSignInDateTime')
            if last_sign_in:
                last_sign_in_dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(last_sign_in.rstrip('Z'))
                if (datetime.datetime.utcnow() - last_sign_in_dt).days > 90:
                    dormant.append(user)
        return dormant
  - name: summarize-dormant
    type: llm
    description: Summarize dormant guest accounts
    config:
      prompt: |
        You are an admin assistant. Summarize the following dormant guest accounts:
        {{input}}
      model: gpt-4
```
